description: This file defines the EmpContractDecorator class, which is a decorator for the EmpContract entity within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to access formatted contract start and end dates, retrieve contract attachments, and associate employees by employee number. The class uses traits for ORM helper functions and date formatting, and interacts with the EmploymentContractService and related entities.

classes.name: EmpContractDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps around the EmpContract entity to provide additional functionalities such as formatted date retrieval, contract attachment fetching, and employee association by employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmpContract entity.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmploymentContractService instance.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the contract, or null if not set.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the contract, or null if not set.

methods.name: getContractAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the contract attachment for the associated employee, or null if none exists.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the contract based on employee number.
